name: Oklahoma County, OK
findings: Oklahoma County has 2,885 nonprofit organizations. 1,178 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 947 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Oklahoma County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 economic development organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 19 would.
